title: ElementFactory (uniform element/integration/hourglass API)
objective: Add an `ElementFactory` that produces element-IR-ready element specifications from a single entry point: `ElementFactory.create(topology, integration='full', hourglass=None)`.
scope: Raise ValueError with a descriptive message on invalid combinations (e.g., reduced integration on tet4).
Hook into `build_context` so the LaTeX `% mechanics cell` directive can also take a `--integration` flag.
implementation_steps: Implement the factory as a pure dispatch table.
Add validation for each (topology, integration, hourglass) triple.
Add `% mechanics cell hex8 --integration reduced --hourglass flanagan_belytschko` support in the parser.
Unit-test every supported triple and 3 invalid combinations.
acceptance_criteria: Every plan-listed combination produces a valid ElementIR.
Invalid combinations raise ValueError with a helpful message.
LaTeX parser accepts the new `--integration` and `--hourglass` flags.

cases: hex8 reduced without hourglass (warning or error per design)

risks: The factory API is shared across multiple downstream phases; a breaking API change later is expensive. Mitigation: pin the signature now and keep it stable for all subsequent tasks.
completion_notes: Added ElementFactory.create(topology, integration, hourglass, formulation, configuration) with pure dispatch-table routing.
6 valid triples across {hex8, hex20, tet4, tet10} x {full, reduced} x {None, flanagan_belytschko}.
Every invalid combo raises ValueError with 'Plan B phase B5' substring.
Frontend wired: cell directive accepts --integration and --hourglass; build_context routes through factory.
Updated 5 frontend guard tests to reflect widened acceptance vocabulary (tet4-full now valid).
Full fast suite: 1193 passed + 8 skipped + 1 expected TODO fail (+11/-8 vs post-P5-5).
